stance_basis: direct quote stating no adverse environmental impact on low income neighborhoods
summary: The Office of Economic Opportunity reviewed the draft environmental statement in coordination with its Regional Office and affected community action agencies, and found no reason to believe the proposed action would have an adverse environmental impact on low income neighborhoods. Their comment was brief and non-objecting, with a note that they would advise if further information was received. The document preparer concurred with their assessment.
complaint_summary: The Office of Economic Opportunity, after reviewing the draft environmental statement with its Regional Office and affected community action agencies, found no reason to believe the proposed action would have an adverse environmental impact on low income neighborhoods.

statement.text: This office in coordination with our Regional Office, and the affected community action agencies have carefully reviewed this statement. On the basis of information from this review, we have no reason to believe that the proposed action will have an adverse environmental impact on the low income neighborhoods involved. Should we receive any further information we will advise.
